title: Integrative analysis of transcriptome and chromatin accessibility reveals promoter-proximal regulation and identifies candidate ABC transporters associated with cold stress responses in maize
growth_system: growth chamber; pots with nutrient soil:vermiculite 2:1; 14/10 h light/dark; PPFD 100 µmol m-2 s-1; 60% RH
control_temperature: 25 °C (control group); RNA-seq contrasts use 0 h (pre-cold) as control
timepoints_duration: RNA-seq at 0, 1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 36, 48 and 72 h of 4 °C; ATAC-seq at 0 and 24 h; phenotype after 4 d at 4 °C plus 24 h recovery
n_libraries: NR (would be 54 if 2 genotypes x 9 time points x 3 reps; separate 25 °C controls at later time points not described)
platform_layout: Illumina NovaSeq 6000, paired-end (read length NR); HISAT2 to B73 RefGen_v5, featureCounts, DESeq2; ATAC-seq on Illumina (platform NR)
other_omics: ATAC-seq (chromatin accessibility, 0 and 24 h); physiology (electrolyte leakage, leaf damage area); RT-qPCR
key_finding: Tolerant ZHB12 shows time-dependent transcriptional divergence from B73, peaking at 24 h, with promoter-proximal chromatin opening and ABC transporter induction.
source_of_details: PMC full text; web search for accession (not found)
notes: No data availability statement in the retrieved PMC text, so accession must be checked on the journal page; both genotypes mapped to B73 v5 (authors note reference-mapping bias); 504 GB clean data; published 25 Jun 2026

title: Integrated genomic and transcriptomic analysis of maize SRC2-like genes highlights divergent roles in abiotic stress responses
genotypes: B73 (RNA-seq); Ds-insertion mutant zmsrc2l2 (phenotyping only; background NR)
growth_system: growth chamber; 14 h light/10 h dark; 26/22 °C day/night; 40% RH; substrate NR
other_factors: drought (mild: soil water content about 35-40% of field capacity at 3 d; severe: SWC <=20% of field capacity at 7 d) and heat (40 °C) in the same experiment; leaf vs root
timepoints_duration: cold and heat sampled at 1, 3, 6, 12 and 24 h; drought at 3 d and 7 d; zmsrc2l2 mutant phenotyped after 3 d of cold
bio_reps: 3 per condition (each a pool of 3 plants)
platform_layout: paired-end reads, platform NR (sequencing by Biomarker Technologies); HISAT2 to B73 RefGen_v4; edgeR counts; DESeq2; FPKM
other_omics: RT-qPCR tissue atlas; physiology of mutant (RWC, SOD/POD/CAT, proline, chlorophyll); subcellular localization
key_finding: ZmSRC2L genes respond in tissue- and stress-specific ways; zmsrc2l2 Ds mutant is drought-sensitive but unchanged under cold or heat.
source_of_details: PMC full text; web search for accession (not found)
notes: Cold, heat and drought share a control (CK) per leaf/root; number of CK libraries per time point not stated; 84 libraries as stated in text; mutant tested for cold only by phenotype (no difference from WT), no RNA-seq of mutant; no data availability statement in retrieved PMC text

title: Dynamic and non-additive gene regulation shapes maize responses to simultaneous salt and cold stress
control_temperature: time 0 h before treatment (from preprint snippet; unverified)
other_factors: salt (300 mM NaCl per preprint snippet) and combined salt+cold
bio_reps: NR (30 libraries per preprint snippet would fit 10 groups x 3 reps, but replicates are not stated)
platform_layout: NR; reads mapped to B73 NAM 5.0 (from preprint snippet)
key_finding: About 74% of DEGs show non-additive responses to combined salt and cold stress across 0-24 h.
source_of_details: abstract + web search (Research Square preprint snippet; not verified as the same study); publisher page not accessible (redirected to a login page)
notes: No PMC full text; details marked 'preprint snippet' come from a web-search summary of the Research Square preprint 'Transcriptional dynamics of maize under cold, salt, and combined salt-cold stress' (https://www.researchsquare.com/article/rs-9877243/v1), which is probably this study; genotype, stage, growth system, replicates, platform and accession need confirmation from the journal article
